def is_number_like(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool) or v is None:
        return False
    if isinstance(v, (int, float, Decimal)):
        return True
    if isinstance(v, str):
        try:
            float(v)
            return True
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return False

def to_number(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool) or v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return int(v) if v.is_integer() else v
    if isinstance(v, Decimal):
        f = float(v)
        return int(f) if f.is_integer() else f
    if isinstance(v, str):
        f = float(v)
        return int(f) if f.is_integer() else f
    return None

header_row = None
for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 20) + 1):
    a = str(ws.cell(r, 1).value).strip().lower() if ws.cell(r, 1).value is not None else ""
    b = str(ws.cell(r, 2).value).strip().lower() if ws.cell(r, 2).value is not None else ""
    c = str(ws.cell(r, 3).value).strip().lower() if ws.cell(r, 3).value is not None else ""
    d = str(ws.cell(r, 4).value).strip().lower() if ws.cell(r, 4).value is not None else ""

        header_row = r
        break

    header_row = 2

data_start = header_row + 1

    pos = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    if song is not None and is_number_like(pos) and song not in previous_positions:
        previous_positions[song] = to_number(pos)

# Fill only E3:E52.  Difference is previous position minus current position,
# so positive values indicate a song has moved up the chart.
for r in range(3, 53):

    song = ws.cell(r, 3).value
    current_pos = ws.cell(r, 4).value
